findings.claim: The required generated AGENTS.md is not added to the repository, so non-Claude harnesses do not get project instructions and the drift check will fail on a missing file.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria require `AGENTS.md SHALL be generated from CLAUDE.md`; `scripts/agent-team/gen-agents-md.mjs` checks `AGENTS.md` at `const out = path.join(root, "AGENTS.md")`, but the diff contains no `diff --git a/AGENTS.md` hunk.
findings.suggested_fix: Run `node scripts/agent-team/gen-agents-md.mjs` and commit the generated `AGENTS.md`.

findings.claim: The hook tests and CI reference compiled `.claude/hooks/dist/*.mjs` files, but the diff adds only `src/` and tests, not the committed `dist/` output they import.
findings.evidence: `flush.test.mjs` imports `../dist/lib/flush.mjs`, other tests and workflow steps execute `.claude/hooks/dist/*.mjs`, and `.github/workflows/agent-tooling.yml` runs `npm --prefix .claude/hooks run check:dist`; the diff has no `.claude/hooks/dist/` hunks for the newly added hook sources.
findings.suggested_fix: Build the hook toolchain and commit the generated `.claude/hooks/dist/` files, or change tests/workflow to build before importing dist and stop requiring committed dist.

findings.claim: The required documentation of Kimi and MiniMax harness limitations is not updated in the diff.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion `Per-harness limitations are explicit` says `docs/agent-team.md SHALL list the limitation`; the diff adds Harness-card text in generated agent files and evidence, but contains no `diff --git a/docs/agent-team.md` hunk documenting Kimi's ignored per-role model or MiniMax's `MINIMAX_DATA_DIR`/missing exec selector limitations.
findings.suggested_fix: Update `docs/agent-team.md` to list each harness limitation required by the criterion and commit the change.
